extName.message: DownVid: video, music and photo downloader

extDescription.message: Download videos, music and photos from YouTube, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, Facebook, SoundCloud and any page with MP4/HLS video, using the DownVid API.

emptyHint.message: Open a page with a video, or paste a link above.

statusExtracting.message: Looking for videos, audio and photos…

statusMusic.message: Finding this song on YouTube Music…

statusSession.message: Reading it with your browser session…

statusSniffer.message: Checking the videos this tab played…

errNetwork.message: Could not reach the DownVid server. Check your connection.

errRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errRateLimitedRetry.message: Too many requests. Try again in $1 s.

errBusy.message: The server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

errBadUrl.message: This is not a public http(s) link.

errNoMedia.message: No video, audio or photo found on this page. If the page has a player, play the video and try again.

errLoginRequired.message: Only people signed in to $1 can see this. Sign in to $1 in this browser and try again: the extension reads it with your session (it never leaves your browser).

jobExpired.message: The server no longer has this job.

menuPage.message: Download from this page with DownVid

disclaimerText.message: Use DownVid only with content that is your own, public, or that you are authorized to download, respecting each platform's terms of service and copyright. You are responsible for how you use the downloaded files.

disclaimerServer.message: Links are processed by the DownVid API server, which downloads the media and keeps the file for a short time. Your logins are never sent: content only signed-in users can see is read in your browser and only the post data is sent.

optMusicAudioHint.message: YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Spotify, Deezer and Apple Music.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file

optSnifferHint.message: Records the MP4/HLS requests a page makes (like the app's hidden player), so players that load their streams with JavaScript can be downloaded. The list stays in the browser until you use it.
